metadata.title: A planar program for the two-variable Jacobian conjecture: a theorem ladder, staircase transport, and machine certificates at the (72,108) frontier
metadata.description:
Paper B of a three-paper research record. The two-variable Jacobian conjecture remains open after the 2026 counterexample in dimension 3. This paper develops the planar program and an exact-arithmetic campaign on the lone open degree pair (72,108) below 125, built on Guccione-Guccione-Horruitiner-Valqui (arXiv:2204.14178, Proposition 4.3). Version 0.28 retains the complete weighted three-parameter T_B cover and advances the first higher-dimensional constructible reduction from the 24-parameter cyclic core. With X=A^3 and Y=A^2 C, direction (2,9) gives the exact shared determinant A^87(R(X,B)+Y S(X,B)), where R and S are coprime. A second exact minor covers a dense open of the rational exceptional graph and leaves three plane factor curves F3, F6, and F7. Exact divisor norms reduce those curves to seven factor appearances. CRT analysis identifies two repeated geometric blocks, so the union has five squarefree factors of total degree 75 rather than 102. The h7 section covers the unique degree-15 and degree-30 blocks. Two additional exact maximal-minor sections have norm ideals that are units on the remaining F7 blocks of degrees 3, 9, and 18. Thus the accumulated atlas covers the complete AS nonzero rational graph. The finite base locus, A=0 boundary, full four-parameter restriction, 24-parameter core, full 51-parameter family, complete (72,108) case, planar degree floor, and JC(2) remain open.

All scripts, artifacts and verdicts: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH (problems/algebraic-geometry/jacobian-conjecture).
